faqQ1: What does the registration fee include?
faqA1:
Includes: all sessions of the 4-day 3-night summit and 5 meals.
(Note: Registration fee is primarily in NTD. Airfare and accommodation are not included.)
faqQ2: When does the early bird discount end?
faqA2: The early bird price of $350 USD expires on June 30, 2026. The standard price of $580 USD will apply after that date.
faqQ3: Can I request a refund or transfer my registration if I'm unable to attend?
faqA3Intro: Yes, but with conditions. As this is a large-scale international conference (Oct 20–23), venue logistics and guest arrangements must be finalized months in advance. The following rules apply:
faqA3B1: On or before August 31: A 50% refund of the amount paid will be issued after deducting the 10% Neweb payment processing fee.
faqA3B2: From September 1 onwards: All administrative and logistical preparations will have entered final production. No refund requests will be accepted under any circumstances.
faqA3B3: Registration Transfer: To protect your investment, we strongly recommend transferring your spot if you are unable to attend. Please email service@ct.org.tw no later than October 13 (one week before the event) with the updated attendee information. Requests after this date will not be accepted.
faqA3Footer: In the event of force majeure (e.g., natural disaster, government policy) that causes the event to be cancelled or postponed, refund arrangements will be announced separately by the organizer.
